item.title: Valuation AI Briefing - Wed 25 Nov 2026: Grant Thornton's human-first audit, Stanford on AI detectors in court, how firms really review AI, a hospital's ChatGPT breach
item.description:

  • AI Might Be Flooding State Court Houses, but Proving It Is Another Matter (Stanford HAI)
  • One-Third of 2 Bay Area Courts' Filings May Be AI-Generated, Study Says (Law.com)
  • 97% of firms that use AI have people check at least some outputs (Accounting Today)
  • AICPA publishes proposed updates to SOC 2 description criteria (Journal of Accountancy)
  • Proposed SOC 2 changes lower disclosure threshold, add AI disclosures (Accounting Today)
  • Statement Regarding Recent Personal Health Information Security Incident (Tahoe Forest Health System)
  • Healthcare AI Guy Weekly, 11/24
  • AI and Expert Witnesses: Key Conference Takeaways (Bond Solon)
  • Parallel acquires Methodim to accelerate the expansion of its AI agents beyond acute care (Parallel)
  • Defending Physician Hyper-Productivity (FTI Consulting)
  • Savant Labs Brings Token-Efficient Finance Workflows to Gemini (EIN Presswire)
  • ILS (Intelligent Legal Solutions) Raises $11 Million Series A Co-Led by Aquiline and BlackFin (Business Wire)

  • IRS official signals additional guidance on AI, practitioner fees (Journal of Accountancy)
  • Reversa raises €750K to automate regulatory processes with AI agents (Tech.eu)
  • The RICS expert witness standard and the Australian rules (Expert Services International on X)

item.title: Valuation AI Briefing - Tue 24 Nov 2026: ASA on AO-41, Northern Ireland's expert AI declaration, Expert Institute AI rules, Houston Methodist's 3-to-1 AI ROI bar
